overview: In Manhattan, a bike messenger picks up an envelope that attracts the interest of a dirty cop, who pursues the cyclist throughout the city.

recs.blurb: In New York City, a crime lord's right-hand man is seduced by a woman seeking retribution.
A fearless cop is taking on a ruthless crimelord. He knew the risks. He just didn't know how far he would have to go.
After watching their respective partners die, a cop and a hitman form an alliance in order to bring down their common enemy.
An uptight by-the-book cop must protect the widow of a drug boss from crooked cops and gunmen.
A vigilante homeless man pulls into a new city and finds himself trapped in urban chaos, a city where crime rules and where the city's crime boss reigns…
Welcome to Sin City. This town beckons to the tough, the corrupt, the brokenhearted. Some call it dark… Hard-boiled. Then there are those who call it home …
An international terrorist has New York in a grip of panic and it's up to Det. Sgt. Deke DaSilva to take him down.
A former race car driver is abducted by a mysterious thief and forced to be the wheel-man for a crime that puts them both in the sights of the cops and the mob.
A corrupt cop gets in over his head when he tries to assassinate a beautiful Russian hit-woman.
In the combustible action franchise's final installment, maverick detectives Martin Riggs and Roger Murtaugh square off against Asian mobster Wah Sing Ku…
Two veteran New York City detectives work to identify the possible connection between a recent murder and a case they believe they solved years ago; is there a…
